question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up at the top right of the page, enter your name, email and a password, then confirm your email address using the link we send you.
keywords: sign up register new account join

question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page, enter your registered email and follow the reset link we send you. The link stays valid for 30 minutes.
keywords: reset login password forgot change recover

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Go to My Orders in your account and select the order. You will see live tracking. A tracking link is also emailed to you once your order ships.
keywords: where is my order tracking status shipped parcel package

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days and is available in major cities.
keywords: how long shipping take delivery time arrive days

question: How much is the shipping charge?
answer: Shipping is free on orders above 50 dollars. For smaller orders, standard shipping costs 4 dollars and express shipping costs 9 dollars.
keywords: shipping cost fee delivery charges free shipping price

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes, we ship to more than 40 countries. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days and customs charges may apply.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery as long as they are unused and in their original packaging.
keywords: return policy money back days window

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Open My Orders, choose the item, click Return and select a reason. Print the prepaid label and drop the package at any courier point.
keywords: send back return item process label

question: When will I receive my refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after we receive your returned item and go back to your original payment method.
keywords: refund money back get my money reimbursement when

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
answer: Yes. Start a return and choose Exchange, then pick the new size or color. We will ship the replacement as soon as the return is scanned.

question: Can I cancel my order?

keywords: cancel order stop purchase

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?

question: What payment methods do you accept?
